newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian drivers run amok over station closure.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian drivers run amok over station closure.

text.p: About 200 Indonesian public van drivers went on the rampage on Lombok, east of Bali, over the closing of an old bus station, newspapers and official media reported on Sunday.
The Jakarta Post said drivers in Praya town on Lombok island ran amok on Saturday, attacking public and government buildings but there were no reports of casualties or arrests.

"There were no casualties or arrests. Life has returned to normal thanks to the quick handling of the riots by security authorities," armed forces spokesman Brigadier-General Slamet Supriadi was quoted by the newspaper as saying.
The official Antara news agency reported the drivers were angry because the new terminal was outside the town while the old one was close to the downtown market.
The drivers complained that their incomes would fall because people were reluctant to use the new terminal.
